pkgmetadata.longdescription: A Falkon browser plugin that replaces Falkon's own password store with KeePassXC, over KeePassXC's browser-integration protocol. It fills logins on page load (including login forms inside iframes), saves and updates them through Falkon's Remember/Update bar, handles passkeys (WebAuthn) through KeePassXC, and adds a toolbar button listing the current site's accounts with copy username / password / TOTP actions, a right-click fill menu and a fill shortcut. Installed system-wide into Falkon's plugin directory; it runs on Falkon's embedded Python and PySide.
